_about: Items. `art` is the item's sprite (art/sprites/item_<id>.png, drawn by tools/item_art.py); `icon` is a GameIcon name (Fairyland/UI/GameIcon.swift) used when there's no art; weapons are drawn in the hero's hand from their art (or icon). Armour `sheets` (per race) swaps in a whole walk sheet while it's worn (Retro Diffusion art in art/sprites; only the skin colour applies), recoloured by `tint` for the rare colour variants bosses drop. Armour `pattern` adds finer detail to the sprite (engraved | scales | fur | runes | pockets). Armour `recolor` changes the outfit colours while worn and `wear` its cut on the hero's sprite (vest | mail | plate | robe | cloak; "boots" for footwear), drawn by Fairyland/Art/GearOverlay.swift. `accent` (#RRGGBB) is the trim colour on the sprite and an accessory's sparkle. `glow` (#RRGGBB) gives a magic weapon a soft light at `glowAt` ([x, y] in its 32×32 art): a halo in the icon (tools/item_art.py) and a gentle pulse while held. type: consumable | weapon | armor | accessory | material. `classes` limits who can equip it (omit = everyone); `level` is the level needed. Materials (type material; `material` is wood | metal | gem | hide) drop from monsters of at least their `level`. `recipe` is what a blacksmith needs to forge the item.
